function.name: git_commit
function.description: Commit selected files while retaining unrelated staged changes. Optional branch must use codex/ prefix.

files.description: Explicit individual workspace-relative files; no directories.

add_all.description: Legacy compatibility only; true is rejected. Select files instead.

create_branch.description: Optional branch name. If provided, creates and checks out this branch before committing (useful for Checkpoints).
